violations.text: Various baked goods packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Establishment is labeled all food items that are available for self-service. New Violation. Correct By: 11/11/2026

The door to the establishment toilet room is not self-closing. Toilet room doors at adjacent to food preparation areas shall be self-closing to limit potential contamination. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
